NYJ.week10_result: Lost 31-12 vs BUF (Nov 15, MetLife). Jets now 2-8 with five straight losses. Geno Smith left twice (concussion check late 1st half, cleared, then ankle late 3rd quarter and ruled out). Rookie Cade Klubnik made his NFL debut (11-of-20, 137 yds, 0 TD, 1 INT). Jets have gone 9+ straight quarters without a TD. WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) and LG Dylan Parham (knee) also left the game.

qb.notes: Smith had left-ankle imaging Mon Nov 16 that showed no major injury (ESPN / Rapoport). He will be evaluated through the week. Aaron Glenn said 'Geno's our starter' and rejected playing the rookie for evaluation, so Smith starts at LAC if healthy. ESPN lists him questionable. If he cannot go, 4th-round rookie Cade Klubnik would make his first NFL start. No practice report yet (first one due Wed Nov 18).

The Inquirer (Nov 17) lists how many games Milton will start as an open question. The Eagles also signed an unnamed veteran QB after Hurts went down.
